text:
Priya: Hey team — hosting a customer workshop in Tribeca tomorrow. Need quick takeout recs near our office. Must include at least two vegetarian options, budget ~$30pp. Any good coffee spots too?

Maya: GreenLeaf Deli on Reade is solid for veg grain bowls and wraps. Fast service. :leafy_green: 

Luca: Momo's Dumplings on Church has veggie dumplings and steam baskets. Call ahead for big orders. :phone:

Omar: Hudson Grill does rotisserie + roasted veg sides, good for sharing if people want heartier food. 10-15 min walk.

Jules: Coffee: Tribeca Roasters on Greenwich — small but great pour-over. Also Baked & Brew at the corner does espresso and pastries.

Priya: Can someone paste addresses/ordering links? I'll run a quick poll and order.

Maya: Sure — GreenLeaf Deli — 123 Reade St — order https://order.example.com/greenleaf, Momo's Dumplings — 58 Church St — call (555) 212-3434, Hudson Grill — 7 Hudson Ave — menu https://hudson.example.com/group-orders, Tribeca Roasters — 90 Greenwich St — walk-in only.

Priya: Poll: React with :green_apple: for GreenLeaf, :dumpling: for Momo's, :poultry_leg: for Hudson Grill, :salad: for Sweetgreen (if anyone prefers). Ordering at 10:30am — please react by 10:25. @here

Luca: :green_apple:

Jules: :dumpling:

Omar: :green_apple: and :salad: (split it)

Priya: Thanks! I'll post the final order here in a bit.

lunchbot: Heads up — kitchen closed for cleaning 11:30-12:00. Plan pickups around that.

Priya: Noted, will schedule pickup for 11:15 so people get food before the workshop.
